The Sewers of Ragni#000.src: Soldier! Good timing. We've been requestin' help for ages.
The Sewers of Ragni#000.dst: ¡Soldado! Justo a tiempo. Llevamos siglos pidiendo ayuda.

The Sewers of Ragni#001.src: With the corrupted hordes terrorisin' the Plains, more and more people are moving to {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#001.dst: Con las hordas corruptas aterrorizando las llanuras, cada vez más gente se muda a {p}.

The Sewers of Ragni#002.src: Issue is, a major sewer pipe's been blocked up. No wonder nobody wanted the job.
The Sewers of Ragni#002.dst: El problema: una tubería principal de las cloacas está atascada. Normal que nadie quisiera el encargo.

The Sewers of Ragni#003.src: I'm going to need ya to get your hands dirty. I'll need some assistance with the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#003.dst: Vas a tener que mancharte las manos. Necesito ayuda con el atasco.

The Sewers of Ragni#004.src: Here's the brief. We get in, deploy small explosives to dislodge the blockage, and get out.
The Sewers of Ragni#004.dst: Este es el plan: entramos, colocamos explosivos pequeños para soltar el atasco y salimos.

The Sewers of Ragni#005.src: We're usin' this side pipe. The larger one down the hill, well... ya don't want to stray too far into that one.
The Sewers of Ragni#005.dst: Iremos por esta tubería lateral. En la grande de ladera abajo, bueno... más vale no adentrarse mucho.

The Sewers of Ragni#006.src: Keep your wits about you in there. All sorts of things could be lurkin'. Ready? Let's go!
The Sewers of Ragni#006.dst: Ahí dentro no bajes la guardia. Puede acechar cualquier cosa. ¿Listo? ¡Vamos!

The Sewers of Ragni#007.src: New Quest Started: The Sewers of {p}

The Sewers of Ragni#008.src: Good, ya caught up. Watch your step around this place, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#008.dst: Bien, me has alcanzado. Cuidado dónde pisas aquí, soldado.

The Sewers of Ragni#009.src: Our scouts've confirmed that this area is clear, but a wrong turn could lead you into the old prison complex.
The Sewers of Ragni#009.dst: Los exploradores dicen que esta zona está despejada, pero un giro equivocado te lleva a la vieja prisión.

The Sewers of Ragni#010.src: I... we really don't want t' end up there.
The Sewers of Ragni#010.dst: Yo... no queremos acabar ahí, de verdad.

The Sewers of Ragni#011.src: Here's a small explosive. I placed one at the blockage already, if that alone doesn't work, use this.
The Sewers of Ragni#011.dst: Toma un explosivo pequeño. Ya coloqué uno en el atasco; si con ese no basta, usa este.

The Sewers of Ragni#014.src: Ah, you're alive! Looks like we underestimated the amount of sewage.
The Sewers of Ragni#014.dst: ¡Ah, estás vivo! Subestimamos la cantidad de aguas negras.

The Sewers of Ragni#015.src: ... ah. This sewer has some history, y'know. Back durin' the {p} Raids, they used to hide civilians here, in the old prison.
The Sewers of Ragni#015.dst: ... ah. Estas cloacas tienen su historia. Durante los Ataques a {p} escondían aquí a civiles, en la vieja prisión.

The Sewers of Ragni#016.src: Let's get out of here. D'you still have the explosive I gave you?
The Sewers of Ragni#016.dst: Salgamos de aquí. ¿Conservas el explosivo que te di?

The Sewers of Ragni#017.src: Phew! Looks like that first explosion cleared the pipe, the {p} citizens are going to be happy.
The Sewers of Ragni#017.dst: ¡Uf! Parece que la primera explosión despejó la tubería. Los ciudadanos de {p} estarán contentos.

The Sewers of Ragni#018.src: ... I don't know exactly what's in there, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#018.dst: ... No sé exactamente qué hay ahí dentro, soldado.

The Sewers of Ragni#019.src: I can't stop you from explorin' the dungeon, but I recommend you gear up first.
The Sewers of Ragni#019.dst: No puedo impedirte explorar la mazmorra, pero te recomiendo equiparte antes.

The Sewers of Ragni#020.src: Legend has it that Bob, the legendary warrior, was born in 'em durin' a raid on {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#020.dst: Cuenta la leyenda que Bob, el guerrero legendario, nació ahí durante un ataque a {p}.

The Sewers of Ragni#021.src: His mother died in childbirth, but some people say she lay down there for years. Rotting. Waiting.
The Sewers of Ragni#021.dst: Su madre murió en el parto, pero hay quien dice que estuvo años tendida ahí abajo. Pudriéndose. Esperando.

The Sewers of Ragni#022.src: But that's just a story! Thanks for your help, soldier, an' good luck.
The Sewers of Ragni#022.dst: ¡Pero no es más que un cuento! Gracias por tu ayuda, soldado, y buena suerte.

The Sewers of Ragni#036.src: Anyway, I've found the blockage. It's right up ahead.
The Sewers of Ragni#036.dst: En fin, ya encontré el atasco. Está justo delante.

The Sewers of Ragni#038.dst: Encuentra la forma de deshacer el atasco.

The Sewers of Ragni#039.src: Find a way out of the spooky sewer.
The Sewers of Ragni#039.dst: Encuentra la salida de estas cloacas siniestras.

The Sewers of Ragni#040.src: Ah, you're alive. Looks like we underestimated the amount of sewage.

The Sewers of Ragni#041.src: I lost you for a bit back there. It's lucky we found each other, to be honest.
The Sewers of Ragni#041.dst: Ahí atrás te perdí un rato. Suerte que volvimos a encontrarnos.
The Sewers of Ragni#041.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#043.src: Sometimes... sometimes it wasn't enough. Some say there are still... things roaming there. Left over from the slaughters.
The Sewers of Ragni#043.dst: A veces... a veces no bastaba. Dicen que aún hay... cosas rondando por ahí. Restos de las matanzas.
The Sewers of Ragni#043.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#045.src: Good, let's use it on this wall, it looks like we can break right through...
The Sewers of Ragni#045.dst: Bien, úsalo en este muro; parece que podemos atravesarlo...
The Sewers of Ragni#045.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#047.src: Phew! Looks like that first explosion cleared the pipe, and the {p} citizens are going to be happy.

The Sewers of Ragni#048.src: And count yourself lucky we didn't run into anything too nasty in there. Some of the stories...
The Sewers of Ragni#048.dst: Y date por afortunado de que no nos topáramos con nada muy feo ahí dentro. Hay cada historia...
The Sewers of Ragni#048.speaker: Jenprest
